title: Codex arm C loads its project hooks in replay sessions
body:
Source: sector sweep 2026-11-19, .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md "Confirmed defect".
Why: a replay/S8 row on a Codex model runs arm C without KRN's project hooks, so its result is invalid.
Evidence: src/harness/codex.ts codexExecArgs passes --ignore-user-config; codex 0.170.0 in a fresh dir prints "Untrusted project-local configuration is disabled"; --trust cannot be combined with --ignore-user-config (probe dir .krn/tmp/trustprobe).
Outcome: a Codex arm-C session loads the arm's hooks (or the harness refuses to run a Codex arm it cannot equip); regression test at the harness-args layer (KRN-14).
Files: src/harness/codex.ts, evals/replay/session-args.ts.
Proof: `node --test test/harness/codex-args.test.ts` passes, asserting a Codex arm-C session receives its hooks or is refused.
